Title: [LSJ] Inspire Greatness and Mask of 1000 faces

Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:
Hello all,

Vampire A is acting. Vampire B plays Inspire Greatness on A. Vampire C
plays mask of 1000 faces.

1) Does C benefit from the previously played Inspire Greatness ?
2) If C had played Inspire Greatness on A before masking, he couldn't
have masked the action, could he ? Similarly, if C had played superior
Cloak the Gathering on A, could he have masked the action ?

Thank you !

-- François

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
François wrote:
> Vampire A is acting. Vampire B plays Inspire Greatness on A. Vampire C
> plays mask of 1000 faces.
>
> 1) Does C benefit from the previously played Inspire Greatness ?

Yes. And note that C must be younger than B, or he can't Mask after
Inspire Greatness.

> 2) If C had played Inspire Greatness on A before masking, he couldn't
> have masked the action, could he ? Similarly, if C had played superior
> Cloak the Gathering on A, could he have masked the action ?

He can't Mask after playing superior Cloak, right, since he could not
have played superior Cloak if he were the acting minion.

For Inspire Greatness, C's got two problems there -- the same one as
Cloak above and the fact that he's not younger than himself.
